evidence_limits: This proves current-host dependency-stage behavior, not a clean Windows installation.
No VC installer was executed and no system DLL, original environment, or source runtime was modified.
The five canonical loaded DLLs were checked by Windows GetModuleFileNameW/version APIs and SHA-256, then matched to Authenticode Valid observations.
The pikepdf hash-renamed runtime is deliberately retained; this is not a CRT-free stage.
Final install/repair/prerequisite detection, elevation, offline acquisition and recovery remain PWS-0802/PWS-0807 checks.

earlier_probe_history.interpretation: Initial scoped successful smoke excluded conventional DLL names but did not count the renamed pikepdf CRT; it does not prove all-CRT absence.
